curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When the gruesome killings start replicating fiction page by page, who—or what—is carrying out the dead persona's work?
curatedMovie.description: After author Thad Beaumont is outed as the man behind pseudonym George Stark, he stages a mock burial for his alter ego—only for brutal murders mirroring his novels to begin in earnest.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Grim, suspenseful horror with a steady mystery pace, best suited for focused solo viewing in the dark.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by George A. Romero, this psychological horror mystery turns an author's discarded pen name into a grim, suspenseful investigation of lethal consequences.
